Data Scientist.title: Data Scientist Career Roadmap
Data Scientist.description: Step-by-step roadmap to become a professional Data Scientist.

stages.title: Programming & Mathematics
stages.description: Master core computational and quantitative thinking essential for data modeling.

stages.title: Data Wrangling & SQL Analysis
stages.description: Learn to extract, clean, query, and transform unstructured and relational datasets.

stages.title: Supervised & Unsupervised Modeling
stages.description: Train predictive algorithms, evaluate generalization, and prevent overfitting.

stages.title: Deep Learning & Production Systems
stages.description: Work with neural networks, modern NLP transformers, and real-world deployment.

Machine Learning Engineer.title: Machine Learning Engineer Career Roadmap
Machine Learning Engineer.description: Engineering-first roadmap to build, deploy, and scale deep learning and ML systems in production.

stages.title: Software Engineering & Math for ML
stages.description: Establish solid coding practices, algorithm analysis, and vector calculus.

stages.title: Model Architecture & Optimization
stages.description: Master gradient descent, backpropagation, CNNs, Transformers, and loss functions.

stages.title: NLP, Computer Vision & Large Models
stages.description: Implement attention mechanisms, HuggingFace pipelines, and fine-tune generative models.

stages.title: Model Deployment & Infrastructure
stages.description: Package models with Docker, configure CI/CD pipelines, and monitor data drift.

Full Stack Web Developer.title: Full Stack Web Developer Career Roadmap
Full Stack Web Developer.description: Complete path from web design fundamentals to full stack architectures and cloud deployment.

stages.title: Client-Side Engineering
stages.description: Build responsive, accessible user interfaces with modern web standards.

stages.title: Component Architecture & State
stages.description: Develop single-page applications with reactive data flow and routing.

stages.title: API Design & Data Persistence
stages.description: Design server-side business logic, handle authentication, and structure databases.

stages.title: Deployment, Containerization & CI/CD
stages.description: Deploy scalable applications with automated pipelines and cloud infrastructure.

Cloud Solutions Architect.title: Cloud Solutions Architect Career Roadmap
Cloud Solutions Architect.description: Learn to design highly available, secure, and cost-efficient cloud infrastructures.

stages.title: Systems, Networking & Virtualization
stages.description: Master OS fundamentals, networking protocols, and virtual machines.

stages.title: Multi-Tier Cloud Architecture
stages.description: Architect scalable compute, storage, and networking on major cloud providers.

stages.title: Kubernetes & Infrastructure as Code
stages.description: Automate infrastructure provisioning and orchestrate microservices.

stages.title: Security, Resiliency & Cost Optimization
stages.description: Implement disaster recovery, zero-trust security, and FinOps budgeting.

Cybersecurity Analyst.title: Cybersecurity Analyst Career Roadmap
Cybersecurity Analyst.description: Master security operations, vulnerability assessment, threat intelligence, and digital defense.

stages.title: Networking & Security Core Principles
stages.description: Understand protocols, encryption, CIA triad, and attack surfaces.

stages.title: Log Analysis & Incident Detection
stages.description: Detect intrusions, analyze SIEM telemetry, and triage security alerts.

stages.title: Vulnerability Testing & Ethical Hacking
stages.description: Identify configuration flaws, exploit vectors, and patch critical weaknesses.

stages.title: Compliance, Risk & Proactive Defense
stages.description: Map adversaries using MITRE ATT&CK and ensure organizational compliance.

Mobile App Developer.title: Mobile App Developer Career Roadmap
Mobile App Developer.description: Step-by-step path to build, test, and ship high-performance iOS and Android native apps.

stages.title: Native Programming Languages
stages.description: Build fluency in modern type-safe languages designed for mobile.

stages.title: Modern UI & Navigation
stages.description: Design responsive, adaptive layouts with reactive component state.

stages.title: Local Storage & Cloud Sync
stages.description: Persist local data securely and communicate with backend web services.

stages.title: Testing, Performance & Publishing
stages.description: Write automated UI tests, profile memory leaks, and submit to App Stores.

Mechanical Design & CAD Engineer.title: Mechanical Design & CAD Engineer Roadmap
Mechanical Design & CAD Engineer.description: Master industrial 3D CAD modeling, GD&T tolerancing, finite element analysis (FEA), and DFM.

stages.title: Engineering Drafting & 3D Parametric CAD
stages.description: Learn 2D drafting, 3D parametric sketch constraints, part assemblies, and SolidWorks/Fusion 360.

stages.title: Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T)
stages.description: Apply ASME Y14.5 dimensioning standards, tolerance stacks, and design for manufacturing.

stages.title: Finite Element Analysis (FEA) with ANSYS
stages.description: Predict stress concentrations, deformation, thermal strain, and safety factors under static & dynamic loads.

stages.title: Design Optimization & Prototype Verification
stages.description: Execute generative design, weight reduction, prototype testing, and production tooling sign-off.

Thermal & Fluid Systems (CFD) Engineer.title: Thermal & Fluid Systems (CFD) Engineer Roadmap
Thermal & Fluid Systems (CFD) Engineer.description: Master applied thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, convective heat transfer, and industrial CFD simulation.

stages.title: Thermodynamics & Fluid Dynamics
stages.description: Master fundamental energy equations, Navier-Stokes, Reynolds numbers, and power cycle analysis.

stages.title: Heat Transfer & Power Cycles
stages.description: Design industrial heat exchangers, cooling jackets, and energy recovery cycles.

stages.title: CFD Meshing, Physics & OpenFOAM
stages.description: Perform computational flow simulations, prism boundary layers, and turbulence modeling.

stages.title: Conjugate Heat Transfer & Aerodynamics
stages.description: Simulate electronics cold plates, aerodynamic vehicle drag, and thermal management systems.

Automotive & Electric Vehicle (EV) Engin.title: Automotive & Electric Vehicle (EV) Engineer Roadmap
Automotive & Electric Vehicle (EV) Engin.description: Comprehensive engineering roadmap for EV powertrain design, battery management systems, and vehicle dynamics.

stages.title: Vehicle Dynamics & Powertrain Mechanics
stages.description: Calculate road loads, tractive force, transmission gear ratios, and chassis handling mechanics.

stages.title: Battery Management Systems (BMS)
stages.description: Model lithium-ion cells, implement State-of-Charge (SOC) estimation, and design thermal cooling circuits.

stages.title: Traction Inverters & Motor Controls
stages.description: Control permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM) using space vector PWM and field-oriented control.

stages.title: CAN Bus, HIL Testing & Functional Safety
stages.description: Integrate vehicle electronic control units (ECUs), CAN network telemetry, and ISO 26262 compliance.

Bioinformatics & Computational Biologist.title: Bioinformatics & Computational Biologist Roadmap
Bioinformatics & Computational Biologist.description: Bridge biological data with algorithmic computer science, genomics pipelines, and drug discovery.

stages.title: Python Programming & Biopython
stages.description: Master data structures, algorithms for sequence alignment, and biological database querying.

stages.title: Next-Gen Sequencing (NGS) & Biostatistics
stages.description: Process high-throughput RNA-Seq and DNA variant datasets using statistical modeling in R.

stages.title: Protein Modeling & Molecular Docking
stages.description: Inspect 3D biomolecular structures and screen small-molecule drug candidates in silico.

stages.title: Machine Learning for Omics & Precision Medicine
stages.description: Deploy predictive machine learning models for disease biomarkers and personalized therapies.

Bioprocess & Fermentation Engineer.title: Bioprocess & Fermentation Engineer Roadmap
Bioprocess & Fermentation Engineer.description: Design, optimize, and scale industrial biomanufacturing bioreactors, cell cultures, and protein purification.

stages.title: Microbiology & Biochemical Stoichiometry
stages.description: Master cellular metabolism, substrate yield coefficients, and microbial growth kinetics.

stages.title: Fermentation Technology & Scale-Up
stages.description: Engineer stirred-tank bioreactors, oxygen mass transfer (kLa), agitation, and fed-batch control.

stages.title: Downstream Processing & Chromatography
stages.description: Purify high-value biological products through ultrafiltration and preparative column chromatography.

stages.title: Process Analytical Technology (PAT) & cGMP
stages.description: Ensure pharmaceutical cGMP compliance, process validation, and online sensor monitoring.

Biomedical Devices & Instrumentation Eng.title: Biomedical Devices & Instrumentation Engineer Roadmap
Biomedical Devices & Instrumentation Eng.description: Engineer physiological biosensors, patient monitoring hardware, diagnostic instruments, and FDA medical devices.

stages.title: Bioinstrumentation Electronics & Signal Conditioning
stages.description: Design low-noise operational amplifier front-ends for microvolt-level biopotential signals (ECG/EEG).

stages.title: Biosensors & Lab-on-a-Chip
stages.description: Implement optical, electrochemical, and microfluidic sensors for point-of-care diagnostics.

stages.title: DSP Filtering & Embedded Device Firmware
stages.description: Filter artifacts with digital signal processing algorithms running on low-power microcontrollers.

stages.title: ISO 13485 Compliance & Medical Device Verification
stages.description: Execute risk management, clinical testing verification, and regulatory compliance for medical devices.

VLSI & Embedded Systems Engineer.title: VLSI & Embedded Systems Engineer Roadmap
VLSI & Embedded Systems Engineer.description: From digital logic gates and Verilog HDL to silicon synthesis, FPGA prototyping, and ARM embedded RTOS firmware.

stages.title: Digital Logic & Verilog HDL
stages.description: Model sequential and combinational RTL circuits, testbenches, and finite state machines.

stages.title: Microcontrollers & Bare-Metal C
stages.description: Write firmware for ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers interfacing with hardware registers and peripherals.

stages.title: FPGA Prototyping & ASIC Synthesis
stages.description: Synthesize digital systems onto FPGAs, close static timing constraints, and verify silicon behavior.

stages.title: Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) & PCB Layout
stages.description: Deploy multitasking FreeRTOS applications and design production printed circuit boards.

Power Systems & Renewable Energy Enginee.title: Power Systems & Renewable Energy Engineer Roadmap
Power Systems & Renewable Energy Enginee.description: Analyze transmission power grids, integrate solar/wind renewable sources, and build smart power electronics.

stages.title: Power System Analysis & Three-Phase Circuits
stages.description: Master AC transmission calculations, symmetrical components, power factor, and transformer operation.

stages.title: Switched-Mode Converters & Inverters
stages.description: Design high-efficiency DC-DC converters and DC-AC grid-tie inverters with pulse-width modulation.

stages.title: Solar PV, Wind & Energy Storage
stages.description: Optimize photovoltaic maximum power point tracking (MPPT) and battery energy storage system integration.

stages.title: Grid Stability, Protection & Modern SCADA
stages.description: Protect power equipment with digital protective relays and ensure grid frequency stability under disturbances.

IoT & Hardware Systems Engineer.title: IoT & Hardware Systems Engineer Roadmap
IoT & Hardware Systems Engineer.description: End-to-end roadmap for building smart connected sensor hardware, custom PCBs, and cloud telemetry gateways.

stages.title: Microcontrollers & Sensor Interfacing
stages.description: Read environmental sensors, control actuators, and write embedded C++ on ESP32 microcontrollers.

stages.title: Custom PCB Design with KiCad
stages.description: Route double-sided PCBs, design power supply stages, and generate production manufacturing files.

stages.title: Wireless Protocols & Cloud Telemetry
stages.description: Stream telemetry to AWS IoT / GCP IoT using lightweight MQTT protocols over Wi-Fi and Bluetooth LE.

stages.title: TinyML & Ultra Low-Power Engineering
stages.description: Optimize power consumption for battery-operated field sensors and run on-device TinyML inference.

Structural Analysis & BIM Engineer.title: Structural Analysis & BIM Engineer Roadmap
Structural Analysis & BIM Engineer.description: Master structural analysis, earthquake engineering, ETABS/STAAD modeling, and Autodesk Revit BIM workflows.

stages.title: Structural Mechanics & Reinforced Concrete
stages.description: Calculate internal forces, bending moments, deflections, and design reinforced concrete elements.

stages.title: ETABS / STAAD Pro Structural Simulation
stages.description: Model multi-story buildings, assign seismic response spectra, and verify drift limits against wind loads.

stages.title: Building Information Modeling (BIM) with Revit
stages.description: Construct parametric BIM models, generate detailed rebar models, and coordinate with MEP disciplines.

stages.title: Foundation Engineering & Construction Management
stages.description: Design raft and pile foundations and manage project budgets using Primavera P6.

Transportation & Infrastructure Engineer.title: Transportation & Infrastructure Engineer Roadmap
Transportation & Infrastructure Engineer.description: Plan highways, optimize traffic flow, design resilient pavement structures, and coordinate GIS networks.

stages.title: Highway Geometric Design
stages.description: Calculate horizontal alignments, vertical crest/sag curves, super-elevation, and sight distances.

stages.title: Traffic Flow Theory & Intersection Modeling
stages.description: Evaluate capacity, level of service (LOS), signal timing splits, and roundabout designs.

stages.title: Pavement Design & Subgrade Mechanics
stages.description: Design flexible asphalt and rigid concrete pavements based on traffic loading and soil CBR values.

stages.title: GIS Transportation Planning & Project Management
stages.description: Map multimodal transit networks in QGIS and supervise construction execution schedules.

Environmental & Water Resources Engineer.title: Environmental & Water Resources Engineer Roadmap
Environmental & Water Resources Engineer.description: Design municipal water treatment plants, biological wastewater purification, and hydraulic flood management.

stages.title: Environmental Chemistry & Water Quality
stages.description: Analyze chemical parameters (BOD, COD, heavy metals) and understand river self-purification mechanisms.

stages.title: Drinking Water Purification Plant Design
stages.description: Size clarifiers, rapid sand filtration beds, ozone/chlorine disinfection, and distribution networks.

stages.title: Biological Wastewater & Resource Recovery
stages.description: Design activated sludge processes, biological nutrient removal (BNR), and anaerobic biogas digestors.

stages.title: Stormwater Hydrology & Flood Risk Modeling
stages.description: Model catchment rainfall-runoff using EPA-SWMM and plan sustainable urban drainage systems (SUDS).

Chemical Process & Plant Design Engineer.title: Chemical Process & Plant Design Engineer Roadmap
Chemical Process & Plant Design Engineer.description: Simulate chemical manufacturing plants in Aspen Plus, design industrial reactors, and ensure plant safety.

stages.title: Thermodynamics & Material/Energy Balances
stages.description: Solve steady-state chemical mass balances, heat of reactions, and phase equilibria.

stages.title: Chemical Reaction Kinetics & Reactor Design
stages.description: Size isothermal and non-isothermal batch, CSTR, and tubular catalytic reactors.

stages.title: Distillation Columns & Flowsheet Simulation
stages.description: Model multi-component fractional distillation, absorption, and heat integration in Aspen Plus.

stages.title: P&ID Development, Hazop & Plant Economics
stages.description: Draft industrial Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&ID), lead Hazop studies, and estimate capital costs.

Materials Science & Nanotechnology Engin.title: Materials Science & Nanotechnology Engineer Roadmap
Materials Science & Nanotechnology Engin.description: Synthesize advanced nanomaterials, manipulate alloy microstructures, and design high-performance composites.

stages.title: Crystallography & Mechanical Behavior
stages.description: Understand atomic bonding, unit cells, dislocation motion, and mechanical deformation modes.

stages.title: Phase Diagrams & Alloy Metallurgy
stages.description: Analyze binary equilibrium phase diagrams, precipitation hardening, and steel heat treatment.

stages.title: Nanoscale Synthesis & Electron Microscopy
stages.description: Synthesize carbon nanotubes, quantum dots, and 2D materials characterized by SEM and TEM.

stages.title: Advanced Composites & Energy Storage Materials
stages.description: Design fiber-reinforced composites, solid-state battery electrolytes, and failure analysis.

Aerospace & Propulsion Engineer.title: Aerospace & Propulsion Engineer Roadmap
Aerospace & Propulsion Engineer.description: Design aerodynamic aircraft, rocket propulsion nozzles, orbital flight trajectories, and lightweight airframes.

stages.title: Aerodynamics & Flight Mechanics
stages.description: Understand compressible flow, lift generation, airfoil polar curves, and aircraft longitudinal stability.

stages.title: Rocket Engines & Gas Dynamics
stages.description: Design supersonic de Laval nozzles, calculate thrust coefficient, and select liquid/solid propellants.

stages.title: Astronautics & Orbital Mechanics
stages.description: Calculate Keplerian orbit transfers, planetary gravity assists, and satellite constellation design.

stages.title: Lightweight Composites & Aeroelasticity
stages.description: Engineer carbon-fiber wing spars, avoid flutter vibration instabilities, and ensure flight safety.

Robotics & Autonomous Systems Engineer.title: Robotics & Autonomous Systems Engineer Roadmap
Robotics & Autonomous Systems Engineer.description: Master robotic manipulator kinematics, dynamics, trajectory planning, ROS 2, and autonomous lidar SLAM.

stages.title: Spatial Math & Manipulator Kinematics
stages.description: Calculate homogeneous transformations, DH parameters, forward and inverse kinematics of multi-axis arms.

stages.title: Robot Dynamics & Feedback Control
stages.description: Formulate Lagrangian dynamics and implement closed-loop PID and computed torque motion controllers.

stages.title: Robot Operating System (ROS 2) & Simulation
stages.description: Build ROS 2 nodes, simulate robot models in Gazebo, and interface depth cameras and 2D/3D lidar.

stages.title: SLAM, Path Planning & Autonomous Systems
stages.description: Deploy Cartographer SLAM, costmap navigation, A* / RRT obstacle avoidance, and field deployment.
